design: Seven noun pairs, two fixed templates, complete subject number x distractor number grid. All 12 directed swaps per valid quartet, categorized subject-only/distractor-only/both. Fixed preMLP4 near token -3, same absolute position. Relative clause uses invariant past-tense noticed for token alignment. No checkpoint changes or outcome-selected replacements.
competence_gate: Per template >=4 valid quartets, >=75% quartets correct binary at all four endpoints, >=50% endpoints intended full-vocabulary top1. All valid cases retained.
scope: Prospective factorial contrasts, not wholly fresh prompts: prepositional opposite-number endpoints intentionally overlap H952. Same source nouns. No fitting; frozen H949 priors.
direction: recipient/donor encode factorial state indices; historical signed margin field is a replay convention, not necessarily an intended answer change.
